rubric.type: Internal editorial visual-craft judgment1–5, subordinate to actual acceptance. Decimals prioritize repairs, not clinical measurement.
rubric.4: Good review art with visible correctable defects.
rubric.4.9: Near-final visual craft after independent reinspection; external acceptance separate.
rubric.5: No observed defect under inspection; never inferred from machine checks.

limitations: These are internal subjective editorial craft scores, not clinical measurements or a claim of master-audit, SLP, owner, child/device or physical-print acceptance.

Score increases reflect actual local repair and clearer native inspection of specific identity/contact/edge evidence. Unchanged accepted cover variants are kept below4.9 where the canonical comparison remains imperfect; no generation is required merely to inflate the number.
Native art commonly~212ppi at7x5; clean on-screen proof does not establish300ppi press suitability.
Canonical/main scenes, accepted21/29 artwork and covers remain protected. No art edited by reviewer.
